description: Source code for the FileStream::Context class handling asynchronous file operations in the net namespace, including open, close, seek, get file info, and flush functionalities.

classes.name: FileStream::Context
classes.description: Handles asynchronous file operations such as open, close, seek, get info, and flush within the net namespace.

methods.name: CallInt64ToInt
methods.description: Converts a 64-bit integer result to a 32-bit integer and runs the callback.

methods.description: Creates an IOResult from a system error code.

methods.name: IOResult::FromFileError
methods.description: Creates an IOResult from a file error and system error code (Android only).

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous opening of a file with specified flags.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous closing of the file.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Asynchronously seeks to a specified offset in the file.

methods.description: Performs the actual file opening operation, handling platform-specific details.
